Photo & Video Booths

Nova Kingdom Rentals offers photo and video booth experiences for weddings, birthdays, graduations, school events, corporate events, and community celebrations across Nova Scotia. Our 360 Video Booth is available now — guests stand on a platform while the camera spins around them for a fun slow-motion 360 video, with an operator and props included. The 360 Video Booth is $399 for 2 hours and $125 each additional hour. The Mirror Photo Booth is available in two formats — Digital ($500 for 2 hours) and Printed ($600 for 2 hours), each with additional hours available.
